method.renderer: Unreal Engine 5.8 offscreen Metal gameplay viewport
method.controlled_state: same saved map, camera offsets, raft transform, crew command, lighting, scalability, and 3 second capture time

matched_frame_metrics.interpretation: The darker sediment-volume response and restrained normal/displacement layers remove most of the long solver-aligned-looking grooves and pale mirror-sheet response in the matched calm launch view. Gradient reductions are descriptive renderer evidence, not perceptual or hydraulic acceptance thresholds.

visual_findings: The regenerated default asset reproduces the retained scalar, volume, normal, and mesh-displacement settings without a runtime material override.
The broad live solver carrier remains optically disabled; only focused masked solver foam is visible, and its raft/crew exclusion contract is unchanged.
The matched launch view shows substantially less streamwise streaking and a more credible dark green-gray sediment response than the prior default.
The calm launch remains intentionally free of fabricated rapid-scale whitewater.
The coarse bright terrain, sparse procedural ecology, provisional hydraulics, simplified raft and crew, and distant analytical VFX still fail photoreal promotion.
